2608.03611.title: Rethinking Modality Reliability in Multimodal Sentiment Analysis with Incomplete Observations
2608.03611.paper_summary: Multimodal Sentiment Analysis (MSA) integrates text, audio, and vision to infer human affect, yet real-world multimodal observations are often incomplete. Existing methods for incomplete-observation MSA mainly follow two paradigms. Reconstruction-based methods recover missing information from observed modalities, while joint-representation methods learn directly from incomplete inputs. Although effective, these methods usually treat modality reliability only implicitly within representation learning or fusion design rather than modeling it explicitly. We argue that modality reliability is a central variable in incomplete-observation settings. Failure to model it explicitly gives rise to two related issues. The first is reliability mismatch, in which the affective evidence retained by each modality varies across samples and missing rates. The second is reliability propagation bias, in which messages from degraded modalities may adversely affect cross-modal interaction and predictive performance. To address these issues, we propose MRCF, a Modality Reliability-Calibrated Framework for MSA with incomplete observations. MRCF contains a Reliability-Aware Branch that estimates sample-specific modality reliability from intramodal quality cues and cross-modal semantic consistency, a Reliability-Guided Interaction Branch that uses the estimated scores to modulate cross-modal information flow, and a Reliability-Calibrated Fusion Module that integrates reliability and semantic cues for final prediction. Experiments on CMU-MOSI, CMU-MOSEI, and CH-SIMS show that MRCF achieves strong performance under standard incomplete-observation protocols. Further analyses provide evidence that explicit reliability modeling helps mitigate reliability mismatch and reliability propagation bias during interaction and fusion.
2608.03611.paper_summary_zh: 多模態情感分析（MSA）整合文本、音頻和視覺以推斷人類情感，但現實世界中的多模態觀察往往是不完整的。現有的針對不完整觀察的MSA方法主要遵循兩種範式。基於重建的方法從觀察到的模態中恢復缺失的信息，而聯合表示的方法則直接從不完整的輸入中學習。雖然這些方法有效，但通常僅在表示學習或融合設計中隱含地處理模態可靠性，而不是明確建模。我們認為模態可靠性是在不完整觀察設置中的一個核心變量。未能明確建模會引發兩個相關問題。第一個是可靠性不匹配，其中每個模態保留的情感證據在樣本和缺失率之間變化。第二個是可靠性傳播偏差，其中來自降級模態的信息可能對跨模態交互和預測性能產生不利影響。為了解決這些問題，我們提出了MRCF，一個針對不完整觀察的模態可靠性校準框架。MRCF包含一個可靠性感知分支，該分支從模態內質量線索和跨模態語義一致性中估計樣本特定的模態可靠性，一個可靠性引導的交互分支，該分支利用估計的分數來調節跨模態信息流，以及一個可靠性校準融合模塊，該模塊整合可靠性和語義線索以進行最終預測。在CMU-MOSI、CMU-MOSEI和CH-SIMS上的實驗表明，MRCF在標準不完整觀察協議下實現了強大的性能。進一步分析提供了證據，表明明確的可靠性建模有助於減輕交互和融合過程中的可靠性不匹配和可靠性傳播偏差。
